audit.why: Tricky anti-AP lane (49.5% over 5436 games): Sylas wins 1-2 before Shield of Durand, 3-6 is an even grind against W's magic reduction and taunt, and item spikes reopen Sylas windows. Content layer describes this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had rows 0-1 as 'Galio' and rows 5-6 as 'Skill' while packet chart and content win[] agree on Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Skill/Skill/Sylas/Sylas.
audit.why: Level 1-2 Galio has no W and loses the range war; first and second item let Sylas push damage through the shield and steal Hero's Entrance.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 5, 6 moved to Sylas with rewritten whys (and row 0 rating); rows 2-4 correctly stay Skill. Content agrees — side-only edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; the flagged missing interaction (Colossal Smash auto-reset as the trade tell) was absent.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7 and is his only engage; Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14 — its downtime is the all-in window; Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 and a premium steal against Hijack's 80s; his passive is an auto-reset.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written in; bleed bullets replaced with the auto-reset tell and taunt-timing facts.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: No Shield of Durand at 1 — your Chain Lash poke and whirl autos win the opener uncontested.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: At 2 you still out-range his thin sustain — keep the Q bounces coming and control trades.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: First item drives damage through his W reduction — Abduct after the shield is spent and chunk him.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items on, you burst him before Shield of Durand resets — and a stolen Hero's Entrance flips his engage.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Abscond (shield-dash) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1 — his only engage; while it is down he cannot start anything. - Shield of Durand is 18s early: bait it with a feint, then all-in the window. - Hero's Entrance is 180s, a premium steal for your 80s Hijack.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His W is a charged channel and his combo opens on Colossal Smash's auto-reset — step back on the wind-up, then chain the whiff.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: His W taunt turns a blind Abduct into a death sentence — commit only after the 18s Shield of Durand is burned, never into it.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Galio wins by catching your Abduct with the W taunt, chaining Justice Punch, and holding you for a jungler collapse.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Galio off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, pin him to mid: shove so Hero's Entrance cannot leave the lane, all-in each spent Shield of Durand, and match his roams.

edits.before: You are whatever the enemy drafted best: steal the fight-flipper, flank with chains, and let W make their focus-fire a rounding error.
edits.after: Late, the grind pays out: burst him before his shield resets, steal Hero's Entrance, and flip his global engage onto his own team.

notes: Level chart: full rows 0-1 said 'Galio' and rows 5-6 'Skill' against packet and content agreeing Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Skill/Skill/Sylas/Sylas — moved all four with rewritten whys; content already agreed so side-only edits. Missing interaction (Colossal Smash auto-reset tell) folded into dosFull[1].d. Packet suspectName 'Shield of Durand's' is a false positive (possessive of the real W name). Content's 'magic damage reduction' claim about Shield of Durand is beyond the Riot kit text (which only says defensive stance/taunt) but is long-established Galio behaviour — left as-is rather than asserting or removing without a source, recording here as unverified-from-kit.
